# Modern Docker Best Practices Plugin ### Container Engineering, Multi-Stage BuildKit & Rootless Security Standards [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Professional modern Docker best practices covering secure and optimized Dockerfile engineering (BuildKit, multi-stage builds, non-root users, cache/secret mounts), modern Compose Spec orchestration (compose.yaml / docker-compose.yaml, healthcheck choreography, network segmentation, Compose Watch), and lean build context filtering with .dockerignore whitelisting.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-docker-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-docker-best-practices ``` --- ## Overview Modern container engineering demands speed, minimal attack surfaces, supply-chain reproducibility, and deterministic local orchestration. This plugin establishes production standards across three essential pillars: 1. **`Dockerfile` Engineering**: BuildKit multi-stage builds, non-root execution, package cache mounts, secret mounts, PID 1 signal management, `STOPSIGNAL`, immutable base images, and polyglot templates (Node.js, Go, Python with `uv`, Java 21 Spring Boot layered jars). 2. **`compose.yaml` Orchestration**: Versionless Compose Spec compliance, healthcheck choreography (`condition: service_healthy`), one-off task execution (`condition: service_completed_successfully`), isolated internal networks (`internal: true`), `stop_grace_period` termination safety, and fast local development loops with Compose Watch. 3. **`.dockerignore` Context Optimization**: Client-side build context pruning, the whitelist allowlist pattern, preventing credential leakage (`.git`, `.env*`), cache stabilization, and passing Git metadata safely via `--build-arg`. --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`modern-docker-engineering.md`](rules/modern-docker-engineering.md)**: Automatically enforces modern Docker engineering standards, BuildKit multi-stage Dockerfiles, non-root/rootless containers, modern Compose Spec orchestration (compose.yaml / docker-compose.yaml), healthcheck choreography, network segmentation, and lean build context filtering with .dockerignore. ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/modern-compose-workflows`](skills/modern-compose-workflows/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when designing, reviewing, or debugging Docker Compose configurations: Compose Spec compliance, healthcheck choreography (service_healthy, service_completed_successfully), network segmentation (internal networks), volume isolation, security hardening, environment variables, Compose Watch, and profiles. - **[`/modern-dockerfile-craftsmanship`](skills/modern-dockerfile-craftsmanship/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when authoring, auditing, optimizing, or refactoring Dockerfiles: BuildKit syntax, multi-stage builds, non-root execution, distroless and minimal base images, layer caching, cache and secret mounts, PID 1 signal propagation, STOPSIGNAL, and container healthchecks. - **[`/modern-dockerignore-context`](skills/modern-dockerignore-context/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when configuring, auditing, or optimizing Docker build contexts and .dockerignore files: context size reduction, BuildKit client-side filtering, whitelist (allowlist) ignore patterns, security leakage prevention (.git, .env), and per-Dockerfile ignore rules. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text modern-docker-best-practices/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── modern-docker-engineering.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── modern-compose-workflows/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-dockerfile-craftsmanship/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-dockerignore-context/ │ └── SKILL.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown - "Optimize this Dockerfile for multi-stage builds, caching, and minimal footprint" - "Audit container security, non-root user execution, and vulnerability scanning" - "Generate production-grade Docker Compose configurations with healthchecks" ``` --- ## 📄 License & Corporate Governance Distributed under the **MIT License**.
